description: Consent to display replacement non Illuminated fascia corporate name signage on side of building.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The advertisment display hereby approved shall be for a period of 5 years
Condition : 2 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission
Condition : 3 - Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity
Condition : 4 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site
Condition : 5 - Any structure or hoarding erected and used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public

Condition : 6 - The erection of the signage shall be erected by using existing building maintenance unit and cradle system. The operators shall be fully trained individuals with appropriate certification in place and the installation shall be undertaken within the weather (wind) tolerances that are compliant with HSE regulations.
Condition : 7 - The sign hereby approved shall not display any moving, or apparently moving, images, animation or exposed cold cathode tubing and shall not have any intermittent light source.

Condition : 8 - The footway and carriageway on the A4 Great West Road and on TLRN shall not be blocked during the installation. Temporary obstructions during the installation shall be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrians or obstruct the flow of traffic. All vehicles associated with the installation shall only park/ stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions.
